item.title: How the Real Linus's Words in the LTT Video Cured My Anxiety
item.description: 📢 This article was translated by gemini-3.5-flash “My data storage approach is I uploaded on the Internet. And if it’s worth saving, somebody else will save it for me (My data storage method is simply uploading it to the Internet; as long as it’s worth keeping, someone will always save it for me)” Although I had seen this widely circulated quote before, I didn’t know its source at the time. Recently, by chance, I learned about LTT and how Linus used AI to fix Linux bugs, …
